distinction: soft, pale, fluffy material
positive: white poodle, Samoyed, Eskimo dog, bee fuzz, baby in blanket, bath towel, Angora, white mixing bowl
negative: limpkin, chime, beacon, golf ball, hard-edged or dark-and-light patterned: collie, tiger

distinction: fluffy curly bushy head against a hard radial metallic form
positive: poodles, spaniels, Dandie Dinmont, soft-coated wheaten, orangutan hair
negative: balloon, car wheel, goblet, dome, compass: hard spoke or arc shapes

distinction: separate dark spots across a coat or surface, versus a plain shaggy face
positive: English setter, German short-haired pointer, dalmatian, Great Dane merle, hyena, leopard, banded gecko, digital clock, analog gauges
negative: Yorkshire and Norfolk terrier faces, daisy, golden retriever, collie, red-breasted merganser: smooth or fluffy single-tone close faces

distinction: a rusty orange-red patch on a soft small body, against a black dark mass
positive: proboscis monkey, ladybug, red fox, red-breasted merganser, brambling breast, Pomeranian, Rhodesian ridgeback, bagel
negative: black or very dark bodies: black cat, black dogs, wombat, hog, water buffalo, three-toed sloth, polecat; it keeps out black

distinction: long repeated parallel things receding in a row (rails, spoons in a rack, burner grates) against compact round natural bodies
positive: electric locomotives and rails in perspective, row of spatulas, steel drum, stove grate, barbershop: rows of hard-edged near-parallel bars
negative: round soft organic bodies on natural ground (rosehip, ladybug, crab, fish held by people, bikers)

distinction: a small bright compact body held apart from a branching or busy ground
positive: goldfinch, chickadee, white stork, ice bear, kite, Samoyed on grass
negative: cats, tabby, lynx, Welsh springer and Blenheim spaniels: striped or two-tone patches

distinction: white or pale body with dark patches on contrasting ground, versus uniform rufous brown
positive: Maltese dog on lap, ptarmigan, dalmatian, Cardigan, miniature schnauzer, kuvasz, Norwegian elkhound, digital clock
negative: redbone, miniature pinscher, Ibizan hound, Blenheim spaniel, buckeye, hamster, tiger: warm reddish brown

distinction: hard-edged machines with a round dial or lens
positive: barometer, steam locomotive, camera, radio, phone, cannon, tile roof
negative: unread

distinction: the pointed nose and snout end of an animal face, against a fluffy furry face
positive: EntleBucher, dingo, toy terrier, red wolf, Cardigan, Great Pyrenees, whippet; heat at the nose
negative: collie, Border collie, Pomeranian, Eskimo dog, Great Pyrenees fluffy face

distinction: a smooth saturated glossy toy-like body against dogs and fur
positive: toyshop figure, forklift, ladybug, lifeboat, ashcan, cab, whistle, tub
negative: dog snouts and eyes: basset, dingo, husky, whippet

distinction: A bundle of parallel narrow tubes or barrels (cylinder, keys, pens), against round discs and dials.
positive: Revolvers (cylinder and barrel), harmonica, ballpoint pens, oboe, assault rifles, trombone, typewriter keys, cornet, barbell, holster, pick. Heat on the barrel or the tube bundle.
negative: Round dials and plates: jinrikisha wheel, steel drum, analog clock, ladle, scale, mortar, barrel, sewing machine, axolotl, coucal, lorikeet.

distinction: one big smooth sloping mass filling an open scene, against small close compact things held near the camera
positive: volcano/valley/alp slopes, tents, yurts, balloons, ski slopes: a single large low peak or dome with a wide empty surround
negative: small bright round or glossy objects seen close up (balls, whistle, oscilloscope trace, small dogs): keeps out near, compact, high-detail things

distinction: a dense curly or radiating round fluff against smooth clothing and people
positive: daisy, poodle, Bedlington, Irish water spaniel, dome with hub, teddy
negative: people in clothes, tench, lab coat, ballplayer

distinction: A rounded body that tapers to a point, with a warm (rust, orange, brown) breast or streaks: a bird in profile, a hull, the body of a cello.
positive: Brambling, junco, bulbul, house finch, robin in profile; paddle, hair slide, cello, cicada, lynx body, speedboat, canoe. Heat on the warm body and not on the head.
negative: Upright, symmetric, man-made: mask, soap dispenser, bell tower, obelisk, dial telephone, barometer, mortarboard crowd.

distinction: Bumpy, knobbly mass made of many small rounded lobes in green: a texture, not an object, and orientation does not matter.
positive: Broccoli (florets in a bowl, close-ups, white backgrounds), cauliflower, rice-and-shrimp bowl, hay roll, Angora fluff, volcano plume, lemon pile, spider on a leaf, planetarium dome.
negative: Sparse lone animals on bare rock (grey fox, bighorn, ibex, impala), rotisserie rows, piano keys, monitors: smooth or sparse, spaced-out items.

distinction: one thin dark upright body against empty light sky or ground
positive: kite, black stork, white stork, ostrich, solar dish, radio telescope, warplanes, sails
negative: people with pets and indoor desks, screens: crowded indoor scenes

distinction: A thin upright stalk carrying a small head or end (a post with a top, a neck with a bill, a leg of a standing animal) against a broad or horizontal shape.
positive: Match heads, ear of wheat, parking meter, bird feeder on a post, spoonbill and ostrich neck, impala grazing, hanging shirts in a wardrobe, parachute, tusker. Heat on the thin upright part.
negative: Instruments and tubes lying or slanting: scabbard, oboe, trombone, pop bottle; also mixing bowl, snail, planetarium: wide curved or shiny shapes.

distinction: a white smooth rounded body, against radial or hard-edged metallic form
positive: giant panda face, black stork, piggy bank, toaster, soccer ball, Shih-Tzu, Maltese
negative: dome, rickshaw wheel, car wheel, cannon, green snake, Siamese cat: spoked or tubular dark-and-light structure

distinction: a soft bright plume or flame rising from a dark base
positive: candle flame, fountain, geyser, crane, white dogs (Bedlington, borzoi)
negative: glossy glasses, dial faces, stopwatch, sunglasses, short-coated dogs

distinction: Long tapering wedge pointing sideways (a snout, hull or bow in side view) against a round or compact frontal shape.
positive: Borzoi, malinois, dhole, red wolf snouts; tank hull; canoe and catamaran bow. Heat sits on the tip of the wedge.
negative: Round or frontal: car wheel, church facade, dome, boxer and French bulldog face, suit, phone.

distinction: a thin curved line or chain of loops against a plain ground
positive: chain links, hummingbird, thunder snake, toucan with wire, necklace, corkscrew spiral, swing with chains, padlock chain, chainlink fence
negative: West Highland and Tibetan terrier faces, combination lock keypad, cassette, Siamese cat, car wheel: fluffy faces and dials

distinction: a rounded, soft-edged head or dial facing the viewer, against a radial or pointed shape
positive: dogs with rounded drooping-eared heads (cocker, clumber, Brittany, Tibetan mastiff), muzzle, clock and safe dials, garden spider body, lamp
negative: radial or pointed things: wallaby and gibbon faces, toilet-tissue stack, iPod wheel, boxer; its inner parent 460 has umbrella, fan and dome as its negative pole

distinction: A big smooth arc or box outline (a spray arc, a bridge arch, a van body) against shapes that radiate from a centre.
positive: Fireboat spray, ambulance, moving van, steel arch bridge, fountain, harp, minivan, pickup, limousine, tabby face, lemur.
negative: Radial or spiky things: umbrella (two kinds), sea urchin, washbasin, barn spider, black widow, plunger, stole, oystercatcher, pop bottles.

distinction: A thin dark curved line or ridge lying across a plain surface (a snake coil, a strap, a curved edge), against smooth long pale things.
positive: Snakes (Indian cobra, garter, thunder snake, sea snake), pool table, cuirass, notebook edge, gas pump handle, harp, camel, cheetah, snorkel, bra strap, mask. Heat on the dark curve.
negative: Smooth long pale or segmented items: corkscrew, cocker spaniel, ear of corn, cucumber, pan pipe, disk brake, chocolate sauce, goblet.

distinction: long wavy hanging ear or fringe, against upright pointed ear
positive: Welsh springer, Brittany, cocker, English setter, Irish water spaniel, red-breasted merganser, swimsuit pattern
negative: white wolf, timber wolf, husky, Samoyed: upright triangular ears; also arch, minibus, bell tower, tent

distinction: a diamond lattice of crossing thin lines (a mesh) between the camera and the subject
positive: chainlink fence at 100% in all 8 top photos; padlock and chain, worm fence, cage with animals behind, ballplayer behind a backstop
negative: table lamp, scuba diver, barometer, hairless dog, crutch, harmonica: smooth single bodies and dials, no crossing lines

distinction: a banded or ridged side panel
positive: ostrich, bunting, jay, isopod, armadillo, freight car
negative: unread

distinction: a dark hooded or peaked shape standing against a bright slope
positive: skiers, abaya, ski mask, sweatshirt hood, mountain, yurt, strawberry trifle
negative: fine radial spokes and thin lines (matchsticks heart, umbrella), vehicles, benches

distinction: fine parallel fibres fanned out from a narrow base, as in a tuft or bristle head
positive: broom, paintbrush, shaving brush, face powder brush, pelican (bill and pouch), komondor mop-hair, lampshade, ruler ticks
negative: smooth compact rounded bodies: partridge, titi, koala, golf ball, shield, catamaran sail

distinction: a dark solid compact body with a smooth outline, against a lighter lumpy background
positive: black dogs and bears, joystick, black kettle, hippo, siamang, abaya: dark mass with highlights
negative: tan, smooth-coated light-brown dogs (bull mastiff, boxer, Rhodesian)

distinction: a lattice of crossing thin lines
positive: chainlink fence, worm fence, ballplayer behind backstop, cage, cougar behind wire
negative: car wheel, washbasin, assault rifle, whiskey jug, analog clock, slow cooker: smooth solids and dials

distinction: a soft round pale mass with a hairy or fluffy edge
positive: Bernese, Border collie, Maltese, Shih-Tzu, ice cream, bell pepper, wild boar, crane
negative: hard small man-made: dial telephone, bicycle, bottles, syringe, necklace

distinction: one big smooth rounded dark bulk rising from a flat plane (water, ground), versus small thin pointed things
positive: grey whale, tusker, hippo, leatherback turtle, sea lion, Indian elephant, black bear: wrinkled grey-brown hulls, whales breaching
negative: standard schnauzer, European gallinule, pencil sharpener, reel, vulture, wolf spider, airliner, violin: thin or small or sharp

distinction: thin straight pointers on a plain round face
positive: analog and wall clocks, stopwatch, compass, barometer dial; drawn clock hands on a white disc fire it at 0.42, a bare disc 0.05
negative: vehicles and pens (fire engine, police van, fountain pen, water buffalo): thick coloured bulk

distinction: a small striped face of a cat, versus a heavy square-jawed dog face and radial things
positive: tabby, lynx, Egyptian cat, tiger cat, kit fox, tiger, leopard: striped fur around a round face
negative: Saint Bernard, bull mastiff, Rottweiler, American Staffordshire, indigo bunting, car wheel: heavy muzzles and radial

distinction: a slender long-legged body seen in side view on open ground, versus a stocky compact body
positive: borzoi, saluki, coyote, malamute, Irish wolfhound, gazelle, llama, oystercatcher, ice bear walking: tall thin legs, narrow head, lone figure on snow, grass or sand
negative: Yorkshire and Norfolk terrier, marmot, wombat, hippo, water buffalo, Maltese: low, round, shaggy, compact. It keeps out squat round bodies

distinction: a smooth plump rounded body half out of its surroundings or held up in front (fish, burrito, seal), versus radial things
positive: barracouta held up, killer whale leaping, black-footed ferret held, burrito, sea lion, gar, Maltese dog on lap
negative: umbrella, dome, car wheel, Egyptian cat, bolo tie, daisy, wall clock, oscilloscope: radial

distinction: An animal head with a snout or beak pushed forward, against a human or frontal face.
positive: Flat-coated retriever, border collie, otterhound, malamute, coyote; also oystercatcher, jay, bulbul, heron beaks. Heat on the snout or beak.
negative: People: tench-holder, boy, suit, graduate, laptop user; also keyboard and candle.

distinction: A rounded cover or hood enclosing a head or object (a mask, hat or cloak), against pointed or spindly bodies.
positive: Gas mask, oxygen mask, abaya, mortarboard, academic gown, lens cap, ski mask, crash helmet, cloak, backpack, motor scooter; heat on the cover.
negative: Pointed wedges and thin legs: killer whale fin, rhinoceros beetle, dragonfly, sea lion, airliner, tarantula, tiger shark, schooner sails.

distinction: a dark rounded dome or smooth convex blob on a lighter ground (helmet, pot lid, hat, head), versus radial dials
positive: Dutch oven lid, hatchet head, shield, bearskin hat, swimsuit, hare, albatross, sunglass; weak (peak 1.0)
negative: car wheel, wall clock, compass, daisy, barometer, analog clock: radial dials

distinction: A symmetric pair of dark rounded shapes joined by a bridge (lenses, cups, headlights, visor), against thin-legged waders.
positive: Brassiere, sunglasses, goggles, crash helmet visor, headlights, grille, orange pair, rain barrels, mask, bolo tie. Heat on the bridge between the pair.
negative: Waders and other thin-legged birds: dowitcher, goose, bulbul, redshank; harvestman, bicycle, screw, stupa.

distinction: The bill tip of a long-billed bird against a plain, flat ground, against frontal dog faces.
positive: European gallinule, redshank, ruddy turnstone, coucal, drake, egret, little blue heron, hummingbird, bee eater, hartebeest horn, robin; heat on the bill.
negative: Frontal dog faces: Italian greyhound, Irish setter, Lakeland terrier, basset, Chihuahua; jersey, lab coat, hoopskirt.

distinction: soft rounded small body, against spindly jointed legs and rigid rods
positive: babies, puppies, Pekinese, Pomeranian, poodle, swing, cradle, dishwasher, wine glass
negative: tabby, corkscrew, remote control, tripod, tick, spiders, Crock Pot, solar dish
